newsitem.title: JAPAN: Possible US rate rise impact on Japan limited--MOF.
newsitem.headline: Possible US rate rise impact on Japan limited--MOF.

text.p: A possible rise in U.S. interest rates would have a limited impact on Japan's financial markets, Haruhiko Kuroda, the president of the Finance Ministry's Institute of Fiscal and Monetary Policy, said on Monday.

Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's congressional testimony last Thursday strengthened a view among many investors that the Fed would tighten its credit stance at its policy-setting meeting on Tuesday.

"With markets having already taken into account a rate rise and affected by the rate prospects, I don't think it will have much more impact on markets. It may not have a big impact on currency markets," he told reporters.
However, he added that if New York stock prices fall substantially in the future, this may have an adverse effect on the Japanese economy and financial markets.
